library.fileCovers: Use the file's first page as an owned issue's cover (off = always the catalog's cover art)
library.fileCoversNote: Applies to the issue grid on a series page. Your file's page may differ from the catalog's art when it's a variant cover or a different printing.
library.panelMl: Use the ML panel detector for guided view (off = built-in detection)
library.panelMlNote: Only applies when a panel model is installed on the server. Flipping this re-detects each issue's panel layout once on next open.
library.panelShare: Share panel layouts with the community cache
library.panelShareNote: When on, panel layouts are looked up from a shared cache before detecting (instant guided view for pages others have covered), and your detections and hand-corrections are contributed back. Only panel rectangles and a page-content hash are sent, never image data or filenames.
